edition.zh: 至此 · 第 01 号 · 截至 2026 年 9 月 28 日

identity.en: PhD researcher · first-passage times & AI agents · AI lead
identity.zh: 博士研究者 · 首达时间与 AI 智能体 · AI 负责人

who.en: PhD researcher, University of Bristol — first-passage times of random walks and the evaluation of AI agents · AI lead (R&D), Yuexin International
who.zh: 布里斯托大学博士研究者——随机游走的首达时间与 AI 智能体评测 · 阅信国际 AI 负责人（研发）

highlights.en: First-author paper accepted at UKAIRS 2026 — poster #181, Edinburgh, 25 Nov
highlights.zh: 第一作者论文入选 UKAIRS 2026——11 月 25 日，爱丁堡，181 号海报

highlights.en: Single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E, Jul 2026
highlights.zh: 单作者论文，2026 年 7 月投稿 Physical Review E

highlights.en: Public reproduction archive v1.3.0 · 46 Lean-checked theorems
highlights.zh: 公开复现仓库 v1.3.0 · 46 条 Lean 机器验证定理

papers.title: Skipping the IME? Keyboard-Friendly Multilingual Prompting for LLM Agents
papers.titleZh: 跳过输入法？面向 LLM 智能体的键盘友好多语言提示

statusLabel.zh: 已录用 · 181 号海报，2026 年 11 月 25 日，爱丁堡

papers.title: Geometry-controlled folds of first-passage-time bimodality under localized absorption
papers.titleZh: 局域吸收下首达时间双峰的几何控制折叠

statusLabel.en: Submitted to Physical Review E, Jul 2026
statusLabel.zh: 2026 年 7 月投稿 Physical Review E

papers.title: Programmable multimodality and saddle-node loss of reaction-time peaks under a fixed catalyst budget
papers.titleZh: 固定催化剂预算下反应时间峰的可编程多峰性与鞍结消失

papers.title: Spectral diagnostics and local fixed-budget sensitivity of critical points in finite encounter-reaction models
papers.titleZh: 有限相遇–反应模型中临界点的谱诊断与局部固定预算敏感性

thesis.en: Why can a single target produce two arrival peaks? A year on rings, lattices and catalyst stripes that became a single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E, 46 machine-checked theorems and a public archive anyone can re-run.
thesis.zh: 一个目标，为什么会有两个到达峰？在环、格点与催化条带之间走了一年，走出一篇投往 Physical Review E 的单作者论文、46 条机器核验的定理，和一个谁都能复跑的公开仓库。

title.en: Geometry-controlled folds — submitted to Physical Review E
title.zh: 几何控制的折叠——投稿 Physical Review E

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E, Jul 2026
status.zh: 2026 年 7 月投稿 Physical Review E

card.en: Single-author regular article, the capstone of the double-peak line. Submitted to Physical Review E, 30 Jul 2026.
card.zh: 单作者常规论文，双峰研究线的收官之作。2026 年 7 月 30 日投稿 Physical Review E。

title.en: Why a second peak is born — and dies
title.zh: 第二个峰为何出生，又为何消失

card.en: A shortcut acts as a rank-one killing defect; the late peak vanishes in a saddle-node fold at a threshold b_c ≈ 3.08.
card.zh: 捷径就是一个秩一吸收缺陷；晚峰在阈值 b_c ≈ 3.08 处，经鞍结折叠消失。

card.en: Code, numerical records, interval certificates, Lean sources and HPC job logs, locked by SHA-256 manifests — v1.3.0, Sep 2026.
card.zh: 代码、数值记录、区间算术证书、Lean 源码与超算作业记录，全部由 SHA-256 清单锁定——v1.3.0，2026 年 9 月。

title.en: PhD in Engineering Mathematics, University of Bristol
title.zh: 布里斯托大学工程数学博士

card.en: From 3 Nov 2025 in SEMT: random-walk first-passage times — why a single target can produce two arrival peaks.
card.zh: 2025 年 11 月 3 日起就读于 SEMT：研究随机游走的首达时间——为什么一个目标会有两个到达峰。

thesis.en: Can you skip the input method and just type pinyin to an AI agent? Forty-eight real calls say: for routine work, yes — but homophones collapse, and one word kept in Hanzi brings the meaning back. The first AI paper, accepted at UKAIRS 2026 in Edinburgh.
thesis.zh: 和 AI 智能体说话，能不能跳过输入法、直接敲拼音？48 次真实调用给出的答案是：日常指令可以；可一遇同音词，意思就塌了——只要把关键词留成汉字，意思便回来了。这是第一篇 AI 论文，入选爱丁堡 UKAIRS 2026。

title.en: The key finding: toneless pinyin erases homophones
title.zh: 核心发现：无声调拼音抹掉同音字

card.en: 事实 and 实施 are both ‘shi shi’. Pinyin-only prompts scored 0.333; keeping the key word in Hanzi restored 1.00.
card.zh: 「事实」与「实施」都是 shi shi。纯拼音提示只得 0.333；把关键词留成汉字，就回到 1.00。

title.zh: 录用：第一篇 AI 论文

card.en: UKAIRS 2026 accepted the paper for a poster. The reviewers singled out the ‘shi shi’ example as the message to lead with.
card.zh: UKAIRS 2026 录用本文，以海报展示。评审特别点出「shi shi」这个例子，建议以它开场。

status.zh: 已排期 · 2026 年 11 月 25 日

card.en: 24–25 Nov 2026 at the John McIntyre Conference Centre. A side-by-side demo: toggle from routine prompts to homophone traps.
card.zh: 2026 年 11 月 24–25 日，约翰·麦金泰尔会议中心。并排演示：从日常提示一键切到同音陷阱。

title.en: An AI-native way of doing mathematics
title.zh: 一种 AI 原生的做数学方式

card.en: Models propose, other agents attack, numerics arbitrate, Lean checks the algebra. Belief is earned, not generated.
card.zh: 模型提出，另一组智能体攻击，数值来裁决，Lean 核验代数。信念要靠挣，不靠生成。

thesis.en: Since June 2026, AI lead (R&D) at Yuexin International: the internal AI gateway, an enterprise platform for governed model access, the staff AI assistant, and the connectors that let agents work inside the company's own tools.
thesis.zh: 2026 年 6 月起任阅信国际 AI 负责人（研发）：内部 AI 网关、受治理的企业模型接入平台、员工 AI 助手，以及让智能体在公司自己的工具里干活的连接器。

title.zh: 阅信国际 AI 负责人（研发）

card.en: From June 2026, alongside the PhD: the company's AI platform and model gateway, its AI transformation, and AI for global messaging.
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月起，与读博并行：负责公司的 AI 平台与模型网关、AI 转型，以及面向国际短信业务的 AI 支持。

title.en: YueXin AI Assistant — web and Windows
title.zh: 阅信 AI 助手——网页版与 Windows 版

card.en: Built and launched in a day: a staff assistant with Feishu sign-in, personal quotas, self-serve keys and a Windows client.
card.zh: 一天内做出并上线的员工助手：飞书登录、个人额度、自助领取密钥，外加 Windows 客户端。

title.en: An enterprise platform for governed AI access
title.zh: 企业 AI 统一接入与治理平台

card.en: Organisations, teams, keys, model allow-lists, budgets, a data-loss hook and an audit hash-chain — on the public internet in one week.
card.zh: 组织、团队、密钥、模型白名单、预算、防泄漏回调与审计哈希链——一周之内上线公网。

thesis.en: How a messaging company learns to present itself as an AI company: a first overseas brand push, a logo argued from four sketches into one mark, print kits for two trade floors, and a 93-minute primer that taught the LLM industry through SMS.
thesis.zh: 一家短信公司如何把自己讲成一家 AI 公司：第一次海外品牌行动，一套从四张草图论证出来的标志，两场展会的全套物料，以及一堂用短信讲透大模型行业的 93 分钟入门课。

card.en: With the Yuexin International team at the Wholesale World Congress: partner meetings on routes, passcodes, RCS and eSIM.
card.zh: 随阅信国际团队参加国际电信批发大会：围绕短信路由、验证码、RCS 与 eSIM 的合作会谈。

title.en: ‘Trust Joint 2.0’: a logo system argued into existence
title.zh: 「信榫 2.0」：一套被论证出来的标志

card.en: Four AI-sketched directions, audited for silhouette and similarity, rebuilt by hand on a 1000-unit grid: 20 master files, a 14-page guide.
card.zh: 四个 AI 草图方向，经剪影与相似度审查，在 1000 单位网格上手工重建：20 个母版文件，14 页规范。

title.en: ‘From SMS to Intelligent Channels’: a 93-minute LLM primer
title.zh: 《从短信到智能通道》：93 分钟大模型入门课

card.en: An SMS is billed per 70 characters, a model per token: the whole LLM industry explained through a business the team already knew.
card.zh: 短信按 70 字计一条，大模型按 token 计费：用团队最熟悉的生意，讲透整个大模型行业。

card.en: Three days on the stand with the Yuexin International team, after weeks of meeting research and outreach.
card.zh: 随阅信国际团队在展台站满三天，此前是数周的约见调研与外联。

thesis.en: A Graduate Teacher from the first month of the PhD: problem classes, labs, marking and tutorials — now thirteen teaching roles across eleven units in three schools, run with the same AI-native habits as the research.
thesis.zh: 读博第一个月就站上讲台：习题课、实验课、批改与小班辅导。如今横跨三个学院、11 门课、13 个教学岗位，用的是和做研究一样的 AI 原生工作方式。

card.en: Thirteen teaching roles across eleven units in the Schools of Mathematics, SEMT and CADE — plus a Linear Algebra tutorial group.
card.zh: 数学学院、SEMT 与 CADE 三个学院，11 门课、13 个教学岗位——另加一个线性代数小班。

title.en: A Graduate Teacher from the first term
title.zh: 第一个学期就当上 Graduate Teacher

card.en: Weeks into the PhD: a Demonstrator contract in SEMT and a Graduate Teacher contract in the School of Mathematics.
card.zh: 读博才几周：签下 SEMT 学院的 Demonstrator 合同，以及数学学院的 Graduate Teacher 合同。

thesis.en: Speaking for other PhD students, and for the university: two years as Engineering Mathematics PGR rep, a scholarship reading panel, open days, a science festival — and seven minutes of stand-up about doing a maths PhD.
thesis.zh: 替博士生发声，也替学校待客：连续两年担任工程数学博士生代表，做奖学金评审、开放日学生大使、科学节志愿者——还在台上讲了七分钟关于读数学博士的单口喜剧。

card.en: A month into the PhD: speaking for SEMT's PhD students in school and faculty forums, 2025–26. Academic Rep certificate, July 2026.
card.zh: 入学一个月即接任：2025–26 学年在学院与学部论坛上替 SEMT 博士生发声。2026 年 7 月获学术代表证书。

title.en: Seven minutes of stand-up about a maths PhD
title.zh: 七分钟单口喜剧：读数学博士是什么体验

card.en: The Lighter Side of Research: three workshops, then a set at the Bristol show on 3 June 2026, The Mount Without.
card.zh: The Lighter Side of Research：三次工作坊之后，2026 年 6 月 3 日在布里斯托 The Mount Without 登台。

title.zh: Spärck AI 奖学金评审组

card.en: One of twelve reviewers on a faculty panel scoring applications for a national AI scholarship scheme at Bristol.
card.zh: 理工学部 12 人评审组的一员，为布里斯托的一项全国性 AI 奖学金评审申请。

thesis.en: First-passage maths turned into a product: BioPath takes a site map and a budget and returns where to put the traps — with the proof attached. An Early Career Enterprise Fellowship, a New Enterprise pitch award and a PechaKucha at the Festival of Enterprise.
thesis.zh: 把首达数学做成产品：BioPath 输入场地地图与预算，输出诱捕器该放在哪儿——并附上证明。由此拿到早期职业创业学者计划、New Enterprise 路演奖，并在创业节上做了一场 PechaKucha。

card.en: BioPath — a bio-inspired optimisation tool for precision pest management — won a place in the 2026 cohort of twelve fellows.
card.zh: BioPath——面向精准虫害管理的仿生优化工具——入选 2026 届，全届共 12 位学者。

title.en: The BioPath platform: map in, traps out, proof attached
title.zh: BioPath 平台：地图进，布点出，附证明

card.en: A site map and a budget in; trap coordinates that optimise first-passage capture out — with a proof bundle anyone can re-run.
card.zh: 输入场地地图与预算，输出使首达捕获最优的诱捕器坐标——外加一份谁都能复跑的证明包。

title.en: PechaKucha at the Festival of Enterprise

card.en: Twenty slides, twenty seconds each, at the Arts Complex on 10 June 2026: ‘Map in. Traps out. Proof attached.’
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月 10 日，Arts Complex：二十页幻灯片，每页二十秒——「Map in. Traps out. Proof attached.」

thesis.en: A camera roll kept since 2023, a WeChat studio launched in August 2026, LinkedIn as a public notebook, a home-built bilingual subtitle pipeline — and the long making-of of the site you are reading.
thesis.zh: 2023 年起从未停下的手机影像，2026 年 8 月启动的微信内容工作室，被当作公开笔记本的领英，自己搭的中英双语字幕流水线——还有你正在读的这个网站的漫长幕后。

card.en: Launched August 2026: an agent-run studio turning years of phone footage into short videos for WeChat — a human always presses publish.
card.zh: 2026 年 8 月启动：由智能体运转的工作室，把多年的手机影像做成微信短视频——「发表」键永远由人来按。

title.en: A camera roll as a diary: 3,947 videos
title.zh: 把相机胶卷当日记：3,947 段视频

card.en: September 2023 to August 2026: 140, 1,310, 1,574 and 923 videos a year. Aggregates only — no clip is ever shown.

title.zh: 本站：首达 · 第 01 号

card.en: A live first-passage experiment on one life — at the address that spent 2026 redirecting to LinkedIn.
card.zh: 一场在一段人生上运行的首达实验——就在这个 2026 年一直跳转到领英的网址上。

thesis.en: Summer 2025: a university programme in Silicon Valley and a two-week research internship at LiveX AI, where the question was how to turn messy manuals into Markdown an AI can actually use. The hinge of the turn toward AI — and a walker that is still walking.
thesis.zh: 2025 年夏：硅谷的一段大学研学项目，外加在 LiveX AI 的两周研究实习——课题是怎样把杂乱的产品手册变成 AI 真正用得上的 Markdown。这是转向 AI 的铰链，也是一个至今仍在游走的粒子。

card.en: 4–16 August 2025, Silicon Valley: finding the most reliable way to turn product manuals into clean Markdown for an AI knowledge base.
card.zh: 2025 年 8 月 4 日至 16 日，硅谷：为 AI 知识库寻找把产品手册转成干净 Markdown 的最可靠方法。

card.en: About three weeks on Tianjin University's programme in the Bay Area, run with Founders Space: workshops, company visits, founders.
card.zh: 在天津大学与 Founders Space 合办的湾区项目里待了约三周：工作坊、企业参访、与创业者交流。

title.en: An open retrieval-QA benchmark for document parsers
title.zh: 一个开源的文档解析检索问答基准

card.en: Parsers judged by usefulness, not looks: 5 parsers × 9 documents × 100 questions, with overconfidence tracked.
card.zh: 不看长得像不像，只看有没有用：5 个解析器 × 9 份文档 × 100 道题，并统计过度自信。

thesis.en: Things built in the gaps: a maths guide for the next cohort, a travel-story studio born at a hackathon, a cursor that jumps between screens, bridges that let AI agents hand work to each other — most of them made so that someone else could move faster.
thesis.zh: 见缝插针造出来的东西：留给下一届的数学指北、黑客松里诞生的旅行故事工作室、在屏幕之间跳跃的光标、让 AI 智能体互相交接工作的桥——大多是为了让别人走得更快。

title.zh: London Cuts 旅行故事工作室

card.en: An AI-native travel-story and postcard studio in three visual modes — Fashion, Punk, Cinema — with a live public demo.
card.zh: AI 原生的旅行故事与明信片工作室，三种视觉模式——时装、朋克、电影——附在线公开演示。

card.en: A local-first relationship and identity OS, built by an orchestrated agent factory: 89% of the commits were made by agents.
card.zh: 一个本地优先的人际关系与身份操作系统，由编排好的智能体「工厂」建成：89% 的提交出自智能体。

title.zh: 天津大学数学学院本科生指北

card.en: A guide to studying maths at Tianjin University, written for the cohorts that came after — live at zhouyixiaoxiao.info.
card.zh: 一份在天大学数学的指南，写给后来的每一届——现在在 zhouyixiaoxiao.info。

title.zh: 为 Apple Silicon 重写的 CatchMouse

card.en: A clean Swift rewrite of a 2011 Intel-only utility: global hotkeys send the cursor to the left, centre or right display.
card.zh: 把一个 2011 年、只支持 Intel 的小工具用 Swift 彻底重写：全局快捷键把光标送到左、中、右任一块屏幕。

thesis.en: Tianjin, Hong Kong, Chengdu, Geneva, Bristol: a maths degree with an oar in hand, an exchange year that turned the maths computational, a first internship, and the 3+1 route — the first shortcut, which skipped a year.
thesis.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：一边读数学一边划船的本科，让数学变得可以计算的交换年，第一份实习，以及「3+1」——人生里的第一条捷径，径直跳过了一年。

title.en: Mathematics and Applied Mathematics, Tianjin University
title.zh: 天津大学数学与应用数学

card.en: 2021–2025 in the School of Mathematics, the final year at Bristol via the 3+1 route. Every walker on this site starts here.
card.zh: 2021–2025 年就读于数学学院，最后一年经「3+1」在布里斯托完成。本站每一个游走者，都从这里出发。

card.en: Three years at Tianjin, then the one-year Bristol MSc: the bachelor's and the master's overlapped, and a year was skipped.
card.zh: 天大三年，再读布里斯托一年制硕士：本科与硕士叠在一起，一整年就这样被跳了过去。

card.en: 2023–24 in Hong Kong: PDEs, their numerical solution and applied statistics — where the maths turned computational.
card.zh: 2023–24 年在香港：偏微分方程、数值解法与应用统计——数学从此变得可以计算。

title.en: MSc Engineering Mathematics, University of Bristol
title.zh: 布里斯托大学工程数学硕士

card.en: To Bristol in September 2024: statistical computing, information theory, mathematical biology, methods of AI.
card.zh: 2024 年 9 月来到布里斯托：统计计算、信息论、生物数学建模、人工智能方法。

thesis.en: As at the build date: a poster to present in Edinburgh, a paper submitted to Physical Review E and another in preparation, a desktop agent in development, a new teaching year and a second year as PGR rep. The walkers still in flight.
thesis.zh: 截至建站当日：一张要带去爱丁堡的海报，一篇已投往 Physical Review E、一篇仍在打磨的论文，一个开发中的桌面智能体，新学年的课，以及第二年的博士生代表。这些，是仍在飞行中的游走者。

card.zh: 2026 年 11 月 24–25 日，约翰·麦金泰尔会议中心。并排演示：从日常提示一键切到同音陷阱。

status.zh: 2026 年 7 月投稿 Physical Review E
